description: Structured eval definitions for the RDS Instance Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across workload types (Aurora OLTP, MySQL Multi-AZ, Aurora Global Database, Aurora Serverless v2 bursty) and missing-prerequisite branches. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Aurora PostgreSQL production cluster — Multi-AZ + customer CMK + PITR + Performance Insights
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, Aurora cluster spanning 3 AZs with reader failover
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Aurora PostgreSQL production cluster in us-east-1 for an OLTP orders workload. Cluster name: "prod-orders-pg". Engine aurora-postgresql 16.3. Instance class db.r7g.large. Use KMS customer-managed CMK alias/prod-rds-key. Need a writer + 2 readers across us-east-1a/b/c for read-scaling and failover. 14-day backup retention. Enhanced Monitoring at 30s interval. Performance Insights on. Force SSL via parameter group. Add pgaudit option. Deletion protection on. Master credentials via Secrets Manager. DB subnet group "prod-db-subnet-group" spans 3 AZs. App SG "sg-prod-app" should be the only inbound on port 5432. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=orders. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLUSTER: prod-orders-pg
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: aurora-postgresql 16.3
  [✓] Instance class: db.r7g.large (memory-optimized for buffer cache; Graviton for price/perf)
  [✓] DB subnet group: prod-db-subnet-group spanning 3 AZs (us-east-1a/b/c)
  [✓] Security group: inbound from sg-prod-app on port 5432; rds.force_ssl=1 (defense-in-depth)
  [✓] Encryption: KMS customer-managed CMK (alias/prod-rds-key) — enabled at creation (immutable)
  [✓] Multi-AZ: Aurora cluster spanning 3 AZs (1 writer + 2 readers as failover targets)
  [✓] Automated backups: 14-day retention (backup window: 03:00-04:00 UTC)
  [✓] Enhanced Monitoring: 30-second interval (role: rds-monitoring-role)
  [✓] Performance Insights: Enabled (retention: 7 days)
  [✓] Parameter group: prod-orders-pg-params (rds.force_ssl=1, shared_buffers={DBInstanceClassMemory/4}, log_statement=ddl)
  [✓] Option group: prod-orders-pg-options (pgaudit)
  [✓] Deletion protection: Enabled (on cluster)
  [✓] Master credentials: Secrets Manager (manage-master-user-password)
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=orders
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier prod-orders-pg
  aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier prod-orders-pg-0
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-rds-key
  aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-prod-db
  aws iam get-role --role-name rds-monitoring-role

eval_cases.name: MySQL 8.0 Multi-AZ non-Aurora instance with customer CMK + parameter tuning
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — non-Aurora Multi-AZ with synchronous standby + tuned parameter group
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a MySQL 8.0 RDS instance for a commerce workload in us-east-1. Instance identifier: "commerce-mysql-prod". Instance class db.m7g.large. Multi-AZ (synchronous standby). Storage 200 GB gp3 with 6000 IOPS. Use KMS customer-managed CMK alias/commerce-rds-key. Backup retention 7 days. Enhanced Monitoring 30s. Performance Insights on. Parameter group: tune innodb_buffer_pool_size and max_connections=500. Force secure transport. Auto minor version upgrade on. Deletion protection on. DB subnet group "prod-db-subnet-group" spans 2 AZs. App SG "sg-commerce-app" inbound on 3306. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=commerce. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
INSTANCE: commerce-mysql-prod
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: mysql 8.0
  [✓] Instance class: db.m7g.large (general-purpose; Graviton for price/perf)
  [✓] DB subnet group: prod-db-subnet-group spanning 2 AZs (Multi-AZ requirement)
  [✓] Security group: inbound from sg-commerce-app on port 3306; require_secure_transport=ON (defense-in-depth)
  [✓] Encryption: KMS customer-managed CMK (alias/commerce-rds-key) — enabled at creation (immutable)
  [✓] Multi-AZ: Enabled (synchronous standby in different AZ; failover 60-120s; standby NOT usable for reads)
  [✓] Storage: 200 GB gp3, 6000 IOPS (within 500× storage:IOPS ratio for MySQL)
  [✓] Automated backups: 7-day retention
  [✓] Enhanced Monitoring: 30-second interval (role: rds-monitoring-role)
  [✓] Performance Insights: Enabled (retention: 7 days)
  [✓] Parameter group: commerce-mysql-params (innodb_buffer_pool_size={DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4}, max_connections=500, require_secure_transport=ON)
  [✓] Auto minor version upgrade: Enabled
  [✓] Deletion protection: Enabled
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=commerce
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier commerce-mysql-prod
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/commerce-rds-key
  aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-commerce-db

eval_cases.name: Operator missing KMS CMK and DB subnet group — prerequisites missing
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — KMS CMK ARN and DB subnet group both unprovided
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create a new PostgreSQL RDS instance called "users-db-prod" in us-east-1. It needs to be encrypted. I haven't created a subnet group or decided on a KMS key yet. Engine postgres 16, instance class db.m7g.large. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
INSTANCE: users-db-prod
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] DB subnet group: NOT provided — Multi-AZ requires a subnet group spanning >= 2 AZs
  [✗] Encryption: SSE-KMS requested but KMS CMK ARN/alias not provided (immutable at creation — must decide now)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-subnet-groups
  aws kms list-aliases --query 'Aliases[?starts_with(AliasName, `alias/`)]'

eval_cases.name: Aurora MySQL Global Database with primary + secondary + Backtrack
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Global Database with cross-region DR + Backtrack + per-region CMKs
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Aurora MySQL Global Database for a global commerce workload. Primary cluster "commerce-global-primary" in us-east-1, secondary cluster "commerce-global-secondary" in eu-west-1 (read-only DR). Engine aurora-mysql 8.0. Instance class db.r7g.large. Use separate customer CMKs: alias/commerce-rds-key in us-east-1, alias/commerce-rds-key-eu in eu-west-1. Backtrack window 72 hours on primary. 14-day backup retention. Enhanced Monitoring + Performance Insights on both clusters. Force SSL via cluster parameter group. Deletion protection on both clusters. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=commerce-global. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLUSTER: commerce-global-primary (Global Database: commerce-global)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: aurora-mysql 8.0 (Global Database topology)
  [✓] Instance class: db.r7g.large in each region
  [✓] DB subnet group: per-region subnet group spanning >= 3 AZs
  [✓] Security group: app SG inbound on 3306; require_secure_transport=ON
  [✓] Encryption: KMS customer-managed CMK — per-region (alias/commerce-rds-key in us-east-1, alias/commerce-rds-key-eu in eu-west-1)
  [✓] Multi-AZ: Aurora cluster spanning 3 AZs in each region
  [✓] Global Database: primary us-east-1, secondary eu-west-1 (read-only DR); replication < 1s; failover is one-way (must re-establish reverse)
  [✓] Backtrack: 72-hour window (primary only; Aurora MySQL; not supported on secondary)
  [✓] Automated backups: 14-day retention per cluster
  [✓] Enhanced Monitoring: 30-second interval (both clusters)
  [✓] Performance Insights: Enabled (both clusters)
  [✓] Deletion protection: Enabled (on both clusters)
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=commerce-global
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-global-clusters --global-cluster-identifier commerce-global
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier commerce-global-primary --region us-east-1
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier commerce-global-secondary --region eu-west-1
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/commerce-rds-key --region us-east-1
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/commerce-rds-key-eu --region eu-west-1

eval_cases.name: Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 for bursty SaaS workload (MinCapacity=2)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Serverless v2 with MinCapacity=2 (no cold-start), MaxCapacity=32
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a multi-tenant SaaS workload in us-east-1. Cluster name "saas-tenant-db". Engine aurora-postgresql 16.3. Traffic is bursty — quiet at night, spikes during business hours. MinCapacity 2 (avoid cold-start latency for production), MaxCapacity 32. Use KMS customer-managed CMK alias/saas-rds-key. 7-day backup retention. Enhanced Monitoring 30s. Performance Insights on. Force SSL via cluster parameter group. Deletion protection on. DB subnet group "prod-db-subnet-group" spans 3 AZs. App SG "sg-saas-app" inbound on 5432. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=saas-multitenant. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLUSTER: saas-tenant-db
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: aurora-postgresql 16.3
  [✓] Instance class: db.serverless (Aurora Serverless v2 — EngineMode: provisioned + ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration)
  [✓] Serverless v2: MinCapacity=2 (avoid cold-start latency for production), MaxCapacity=32 (cap cost at peak), SecondsUntilAutoPause=0
  [✓] DB subnet group: prod-db-subnet-group spanning 3 AZs
  [✓] Security group: inbound from sg-saas-app on port 5432; rds.force_ssl=1
  [✓] Encryption: KMS customer-managed CMK (alias/saas-rds-key) — enabled at creation (immutable)
  [✓] Multi-AZ: Aurora cluster spanning 3 AZs (cluster-level, implicit)
  [✓] Automated backups: 7-day retention
  [✓] Enhanced Monitoring: 30-second interval
  [✓] Performance Insights: Enabled
  [✓] Cluster parameter group: rds.force_ssl=1
  [✓] Deletion protection: Enabled (on cluster)
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=saas-multitenant
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier saas-tenant-db
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/saas-rds-key
  aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-saas-db
